title: Building Trust, Communication, and Respect at Work: Enhance Your Multi-Generational Culture
desc: Provides tools on how to build high-performing multi-generational teams (from Silent Generation to Gen Alpha) to innovation, employee engagement, and business success.

title: Effective Internal Quality Auditing
desc: Centers on skill assessment, Lead Auditor capabilities, and strategies to successfully leverage internal auditing logs to drive business improvement.

title: Five Simple Tools You Can Immediately Apply to Remove Waste and Non-Value Adding Activities
desc: Teaches five highly effective tools to reduce waste: Spaghetti Mapping, Point of Use Storage (POUS), Checklists, Self-Inspections, and Error Proofing (Poka-Yoke).

title: Bust These Myths to Achieve Breakthrough Performance
desc: Teaches how to bust long-held performance and quality myths that prevent individuals and organizations from reaching their true potential.

title: Applying Predictive Modeling and Computer Vision (CV) Tools Useful in Biomedicine and Public Health
desc: Examples of applying imaging analytics tools to build predictive models. Covers pelvic injury diagnosis parameters and external-beam radiation target accuracy.
